question.text: Look at all the litter in the park. [^Honestly, some people are|Some people are honestly] so thoughtless.
question.modelAnswerString: Look at all the litter in the park. Honestly, some people are so thoughtless.

question.text: [Honestly, Helena tried to answer his questions|^Helena tried to answer his questions honestly], but she had difficulty remembering much about the accident as it was such a long time ago.
question.modelAnswerString: Helena tried to answer his questions honestly, but she had difficulty remembering much about the accident as it was such a long time ago.

question.text: [Naturally, caffeine occurs|^Caffeine occurs naturally] in more than 60 plants.
question.modelAnswerString: Caffeine occurs naturally in more than 60 plants.

question.text: There's no need to be nervous at the interview. [Naturally, just act|^Just act naturally] and I'm sure you'll get the job.
question.modelAnswerString: There's no need to be nervous at the interview. Just act naturally and I'm sure you'll get the job.

question.text: The room had no pictures on the wall and [plainly was furnished|^was plainly furnished].
question.modelAnswerString: The room had no pictures on the wall and was plainly furnished.

question.text: [^Plainly, Karim wasn't interested|Karim wasn’t interested plainly] in watching the tennis match. He just spent the time reading the newspaper or browsing the Internet on his mobile.
question.modelAnswerString: Plainly, Karim wasn't interested in watching the tennis match. He just spent the time reading the newspaper or browsing the Internet on his mobile.

question.text: It is said that politicians are only interested in power. [^Clearly, this is not the case|This is not clearly the case] for all politicians.
question.modelAnswerString: It is said that politicians are only interested in power. Clearly, this is not the case for all politicians.

question.text: The new road will be built through areas of natural beauty. [^Clearly, some people will object|Some people will object clearly] to this.
question.modelAnswerString: The new road will be built through areas of natural beauty. Clearly, some people will object to this.

question.text: [^Frankly, I think his suggestion is|I think his suggestion is frankly] totally ridiculous.
question.modelAnswerString: Frankly, I think his suggestion is totally ridiculous.

question.text: [Frankly, in her autobiography she writes|^In her autobiography she writes frankly] about her time as Ambassador to the United Nations.
question.modelAnswerString: In her autobiography she writes frankly about her time as Ambassador to the United Nations.
